messages:
sara-cs: P1 from AcmeCorp — they saw a 10m window of 5xx/gateway timeouts hitting /v1/generate around 11:42 PDT. customer says requests hang then 504s, they attached an example curl and logs. escalated to support.

oncall-bot: @channel incident created: INC-2026-0418-01 - api 5xx spikes / potential scaleup lag. notify: eng-sre, eng-runtime.

tyler-sre: looking. can you paste the customer's sample request + rate? also which model variant are they on?

sara-cs: payload attached in thread (large prompt + streaming). they were hitting ~120 r/s from a single region for 2 min, then dropped to 5 r/s. model: redwood/base-13b-qa (hosted).

tyler-sre: thanks. initial hypothesis: scale-up backlog + KEDA polling lag + readiness/warmup delays. seeing similar in metrics this morning for a different tenant. can someone grab the scaler events and pods timeline for that tenant id?

emma-prod: noticed we rolled a probe config change in canary yesterday (readiness timeout from 5s -> 2s) for faster signal. that could make pods fail readiness during heavy startup. rolling back would increase warm start tolerance.

raj-eng: grabbing events. snippet from the kube events for tenant-772:
```
ScaledObject tenant-772 scaled to 0 -> 6 (keda)
Warning  KedaPolling  30s ago  Polling failed: timeout contacting metric server
Normal   HPA         5s ago   target CPU 60% -> desired 6
Normal   Pod        0s ago    pod/model-0 Readiness probe failed: timeout
```

tyler-sre: logs from gateway show queue build up then 502/504 at proxy-level: `upstream read timeout` and many long L7 connections in CLOSE_WAIT. looks like pods are not becoming Ready fast enough, gateway keeps connections open and times out.

sara-cs: customer provided a short repro script. they run 6 concurrent curl streams for 30s then stop. they said errors start ~12s after start.

tyler-sre: repro locally against staging with a smaller burst: created 150 parallel short requests with a sleep. reproduced 504s when pods are scaled from 0 and KEDA poll interval=30s. if I reduce KEDA PollingInterval to 5s or keep a minReplicaCount>0 the issue disappears.

emma-prod: creating rollback PR for readiness timeout change + propose default minReplicaCount=1 for tenants with burst SLA. also propose adding a prewarm flag in tenant config.

raj-eng: temporary mitigation applied: set ScaledObject.minReplicaCount=1 for tenant-772 and bumped KEDA PollingInterval to 6s. observing request success rate climb from 86% -> 99% over last 3m.

billing-bot: noticed token usage spike during repro; alerted finance. FYI for billing anomalies.

tyler-sre: suggested longer-term fixes: 1) increase probe gracePeriod/startupProbe; 2) ensure model init runs in parallel with readiness gating (init async); 3) enable warm-cache prewarming for common prefixes; 4) add KEDA telemetry alert for Polling failures.

sara-cs: communicated mitigations + RCA to customer, asked them to validate on their next burst. they accepted interim mitigations and downgraded urgency.

emma-prod: follow-up tasks: ticket created (ENG-1298) to revert probe change + add per-tenant prewarm opt-in + dashboard panel for scaler poll errors. assigning to @tyler-sre and @raj-eng.

tyler-sre: will follow up with a postmortem with timelines and the exact config diff. thanks all. :thumbsup:

sara-cs: closing loop with customer tomorrow after 24h, will reopen if they see recurrence.
